newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Ahresty forms Thai joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Ahresty forms Thai joint venture.

text.p: Japan's Ahresty Corp said on Monday it had formed a joint venture with Thai Engineering Products Co Ltd to produce metal moulds used in the production of aluminium foundry products.
The venture, Thai Ahresty Die Co Ltd, will be based in Ayutthaya, north of Bangkok, and capitalised at 85 million baht, or about 420 million yen, Ahresty said.
Ahresty will take a 50 percent stake in the venture, Thai Engineering Products 45 percent and the remaining five percent will be held by an Ahresty affiliate.
Annual sales are targetted to reach about 300 million yen by 2003, by which time the workforce is scheduled to have grown to 45 from an initial 34, an Ahresty spokesman said.
The venture's products will be sold to Thai Engineering Products, Thailand's biggest maker of foundry products for car parts and also to a subsidiary of the Siam Cement Co Plc group.
Ahresty is owned 4.2 percent by Honda Motor Co Ltd and makes die-cast vehicle parts.
